notes:
A handwritten cover headed Papiers prêtés, with a separate faint III between upper and lower rules and a parenthetical 8 p whose possible full stops remain doubtful. The title is at upper right; the pencil group is much farther left, with the count below III. No authorial date, verbal hesitation, mathematical statement or calculation is present. The small right-side hooked trace and separate low-left point are preserved without assigning them a character or function. Their origin as intentional writing, and particularly the detached point’s relation to the surface, remain uncertain. The bottom 1 is archive metadata and remains a comment.

H describes the cover and adds editorial observations about the following register. Those observations are not words on this cover and do not enter the transcription or count as invented source prose. Its III uncertainty can be resolved from the three stems, and its illegible parenthesis can be read as 8 p with local punctuation doubts. C’s two punctuation doubts are retained. The physical placement of C’s margin macros is replaced by the observed arrangement.

C’s earlier note says that eight written sheets follow the cover. The current package map was counted in this run: it contains eight subsequent 162-1 scan entries, 003–010. That documentary count is consistent with the possible cover count, but does not establish the meaning of p, physical recto/verso sheet identity, or the content of any following page. The single-page readers did not claim to check those later sheets. No mathematical proof event is inferred from reading this cover.
